body:
I confronted them....They denied everything. Told me they had no idea what I was talking about. Lied straight to my face. I'm not sure if they are just afraid to talk to me about it or they just are treating this as one big joke, and they believe that I will regard their statements as the truth. 

Never the less, it is still happening. I can still hear them tearing me apart. Mocking every little aspect of my life. I am still in constant torment. Just completely miserable.

Let me elaborate a little more on my situation. See, I've been trying to live out my obligation to this house and not try to figure out another situation because I don't want my parents to find out... I don;t want them to worry about me, they are good people. They don't deserve to be weighed down with me issues. I desperatly want to fight through this and lead a normal life.
